The '''blast mine''' is an activity which grants [[Mining]] and [[Firemaking]] experience.

Blast mining requires level 43 Mining to participate, as well as a [[chisel]], [[tinderbox]], and [[dynamite]]. Dynamite can be made by combining [[volcanic sulphur]], [[juniper charcoal]], [[saltpetre]], and a [[pot]], then adding a [[ball of wool]] to the resulting [[dynamite pot]]. Alternatively, dynamite can be obtained from [[Thirus]] nearby.

Players use dynamite to blast chunks of valuable [[ores]] from within hard rock, which must then be washed before the chunks disintegrate.

There are bank chests in the area which players can use to retrieve dynamite as needed and to deposit collected ores.
